snippet.title: Cook Serve Forever Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Are you ready to get cooking? Cook Serve Forever is out now on Consoles and PC!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928090/Cook_Serve_Forever/
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/cook-serve-forever-switch/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10010773
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/cook-serve-forever/9pc0tn6k63tp

Put your culinary skills to the test as Nori Kaga, a food cart chef aspiring to make it like her role model Chef Rhubarb.

With over 80 foods and 400 recipes, Cook Serve Forever will see you and your food cart travel to over 50 locations around the bustling solarpunk city of Helianthus on your quest for greatness.
